meta.description: Documented placeholder for the first SyncCore intake workflow. Realistic Phase 3 flow: Webhook trigger -> Normalize payload -> HTTP request to /api/events/ingest or future direct Postgres insert -> Switch by event type -> Execute downstream workflow placeholder.

nodes.name: Billing Webhook Trigger
nodes.notes: Receives Stripe-like demo billing events first. Later this can verify real provider signatures.

nodes.name: Normalize Event Payload
nodes.notes: Normalize provider_event_id, event_type, customer, subscription, amount, currency, account_domain, crm_company_id, usage_density, and timestamps.

nodes.name: HTTP Request to Dashboard Ingest
nodes.notes: Preferred Phase 3 bridge. POST the normalized payload to /api/events/ingest so the dashboard app owns the idempotent event_log write.

nodes.name: Route By Event Type
nodes.notes: Route customer.subscription.updated, customer.subscription.deleted, invoice.payment_failed, invoice.paid, and unknown events.

nodes.name: Direct Postgres Insert (Future Option)
nodes.notes: Optional future path if SyncCore later decides n8n should insert directly into Postgres.

nodes.name: Downstream Workflow Placeholder
nodes.notes: Represents the next lifecycle sync, churn defuser, or reconciliation workflow after event_log has been written.
